title: Pilot who flew the gold out is still alive

tellings.quote: He's still alive. The the commander, the pilot that flew the flew the gold out.

plain: The commander who flew a load of gold out, in a story set in 1945, is still alive, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells Michels, "He's still alive, the commander, the pilot that flew the gold out." He names no source, and he does not say here whose gold it was or where it went. If true, someone who took part in the episode could still speak about it.
